text:
oliver (BillingOps): Noticed ~47 invoices posted to the wrong NetSuite subsidiary (US_Main) instead of APAC_Subsidiary. Looks like it started after the mapper change last night.

jules (Finance): How bad is wrong-sub? tax/treatment differences?

oliver (BillingOps): Most are APAC customers billed in USD, tax code should've been GST_APAC but NS recorded US_SALES tax instead. Could affect tax reports and tax withholding.

webhook-bot: [INFO] 47 NetSuite invoices created with subsidiary=US_Main since 2024-06-11T23:10Z. Visible in /alerts/4571.

sana (Eng): Quick root cause: mapper was switched to use Stripe `region` metadata for subsidiary routing (was using `country`) to support geolocation experiments. The deploy used a mapping table with keys like `APAC`, `EMEA`, `NA`. Stripe events have `region` lowercased (`apac`), so lookup failed and defaulted to US_Main.

ophelia (CS): So this is basically a case mismatch? Are customers impacted financially?

jules (Finance): Potentially. Wrong subsidiary can change legal entity, tax code, and AR ownership. Need to correct in NetSuite for invoices created in the last 8 hours. Also audit trail for tax authority.

oliver (BillingOps): Proposed mitigations: 1) revert mapper to fallback to `country` then `region` to minimize further impact; 2) patch mapping lookup to lowercase keys and accept both `region` and `geo_region`; 3) run idempotent upsert backfill to correct subsidiary and tax codes.

sana (Eng): I'll push a config hotfix that lowercases region keys and restores country fallback. Deploying now to staging, will promote to prod after smoke.

webhook-bot: [DEPLOY] mapper-service v2.19.3 -> staging by sana at 2024-06-12T00:05Z.

sana (Eng): Hotfix to accept case-insensitive region and `geo_region` applied to prod at 2024-06-12T00:18Z. Patch also logs mismatched region values to Sentry for manual review.

jules (Finance): For the backfill: make sure we only update subsidiary/tax fields and do not create new invoice numbers. Also capture pre/post snapshots for audit.

sana (Eng): Backfill plan: use external_id upsert, limit to fields {subsidiary, tax_code, posting_class}, and attach a journal memo `CORR: region-mapper bug`. Running dry-run now with sample id list. Command: `./scripts/ns_backfill --ids /tmp/region_bad_ids.txt --fields subsidiary,tax_code --dry-run`

oliver (BillingOps): share sample transformed payload from dry-run so finance can review expected tax_code changes.

sana (Eng): Sample payload (dry-run):

```
{
  "external_id": "stripe_inv_7abC",
  "customer_external_id": "cus_3PLm",
  "amount": 45000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "subsidiary": "APAC_Subsidiary",
  "tax_code": "GST_APAC",
  "metadata": { "region": "apac", "geo_region": "apac" }
}
```

jules (Finance): That looks right. Please ensure posting date and AR buckets unchanged. We'll review audit snapshot after dry-run.

ophelia (CS): I'll prepare a short customer note explaining there was a metadata routing bug that affected entity assignment; reassure customers that their invoice amounts didn't change and that we're correcting bookkeeping entries.

oliver (BillingOps): Action items: (1) sana finalize/prod hotfix (done), (2) sana run full backfill in 30min with `--upsert-fields subsidiary,tax_code --audit-log /var/backfills/region_fix.log`, (3) jules validate GLs/posting and sign-off before support sends external comms.

sana (Eng): Starting backfill (2024-06-12T00:45Z). Command: `./scripts/ns_backfill --ids /tmp/region_bad_ids.txt --upsert-fields subsidiary,tax_code --audit-log /var/backfills/region_fix.log`

webhook-bot: [BACKFILL] 47 invoices processed, 47 updated (no duplicates) at 2024-06-12T00:52Z. Details: /backfills/region_fix.log

jules (Finance): Verified samples and GL snapshots. Subsidiary and tax codes corrected, posting buckets intact. We'll prepare a reconciliation report for tax team.

oliver (BillingOps): Thanks everyone. Closing once tax team confirms.

ophelia (CS): Drafted customer message, will hold until jules OKs.

jules (Finance): OK to send external comms. tagging tax-team to confirm internal filing: @tax-team.

oliver (BillingOps): Closing thread. Notes: add an alert for region value mismatches to avoid silent fallback next time.
